title: Derive typed client output from the OpenAPI document

gates.G1: Independent EF-106 review found the client generator emitted a fixed template rather than deriving types from the generated OpenAPI contract.
gates.G2: EF-106 Training Demo plan is approved by docs/handoffs/EF-007-scope-approval.md.
gates.G3: Mamdouh explicitly approved this corrective packet: نعم (2026-07-28).

objective: Repair only the EF-106 client-generation boundary so generated TypeScript is mechanically derived from the generated OpenAPI document, preserving its narrow health-only scope.
forbidden: No API endpoint, database, Docker/integration stack, auth, external service, listener, commit, push, or deploy.
No generic arbitrary-schema code generator: support exactly the documented health response schemas and fail clearly if their required OpenAPI shape is absent.
No manual edit to generated.ts except through the approved generator script.
acceptance: OpenAPI carries stable operation IDs for the two health GET operations, and the generator obtains client method names, URL paths, and HealthStatus status literal union from the document rather than a fixed client template.

A pure generator test feeds an isolated copied document whose status enum is altered and proves emitted TypeScript changes to include the altered union; it also proves unsupported/missing operation schema fails safely.
Regenerated tracked openapi.json/generated.ts are deterministic across two runs; normal drift check passes and isolated drift negative proof still fails without tracked-file mutation.
Existing health and fake-fetch client behavior remains green; full non-integration canonical quality suite passes.
Update EF-106 task/handoff to done only after all checks pass, otherwise preserve truthful partial state.
verification: TDD RED then GREEN for altered schema and invalid schema generator behavior.
